args.title: Update password reset email link to use PUBLIC_URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email contains a link pointing to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…'. This link should use the environment variable PUBLIC_URL instead of a hard-coded localhost address. The change will ensure that the password reset link directs users to the correct URL based on the environment.
